summary: This package establishes a modular framework for AI-driven application development, providing core abstractions for model registry management, request routing, provider integration, tool execution, and prompt versioning to ensure consistent AI service orchestration.
responsibilities: Manage AI model registry and configuration
Orchestrate model request routing and fallback logic
Provide structured error handling and diagnostics
relationships: The routing service maps requests to specific models defined within the AI model registry.
Provider implementations adhere to service interfaces to execute tasks initiated by the routing layer.
AI tools provide supplemental capabilities that are executed within a managed context defined by the execution pipeline.
Prompt repositories provide the templates used by models during request generation.
Error handling mechanisms provide consistent diagnostic context across all layers of the model execution process.
designDecisions: Interface-based design for decoupling provider and repository logic
Use of Effect context for dependency injection and service management
Layered architecture separating execution orchestration from concrete service implementation
Centralized registry pattern for service and model discovery
Schema-driven validation for data structures and prompt definitions
Decorator pattern for injecting cross-cutting concerns like retries and approval policies
